title: Demonstratives in the plural genitive
summary: Use näiden, noiden or niiden before a plural genitive noun: näiden talojen ovet (“the doors of these houses”).
prerequisiteSkills: Adjective agreement in the singular genitive
objectives: Use näiden, noiden or niiden before a plural genitive noun: näiden talojen ovet (“the doors of these houses”).

sections.title: Meaning and pattern
paragraphs: A demonstrative identifies which noun is meant. Its case and number agree with that noun, while its reference distinguishes near, farther away, and already mentioned.
Use nämä → näiden/näitten (“these”), nuo → noiden/noitten (“those” farther away), ne → niiden/niitten (“the/those” already mentioned). Both forms in each pair are standard.
The noun genitives and surrounding head nouns are provided. Reference cues choose among demonstratives; the genitive ending alone does not choose the reference.
